scope: publisher.rs only; existing S3Client, intent, object, manifest, HEAD/readback and checkpoint contracts unchanged. No monitoring threshold changes.

liveness.checkpoint: old durable checkpoint until the coordinator joins successful remote work and completes a final successful status write
liveness.failure: All workers joined before returning. Reporting errors block local commit and request cancellation before later remote steps where possible. Requests already in flight are not cancelled. A remote HEAD may finish first; retained exact intent reconciles replay.
liveness.completion: Immediate phase=waiting,in_flight=false status after each completed batch.
liveness.last_durable_progress_unix_ms: null after startup until this process completes a durable batch; timer reports never change it.
liveness.slow_batch_log: One fixed JSON event on successful completion only when upload_commit_ms>=60000; numeric timing/counts/sequences only.

tests.host_execution: Parent will run on exact clean donor; no local Cargo build due disk limit.
